title: dryopteris lobata
intro: Dryopteris lobata, commonly known as Lobed Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to Eastern Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris lobata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
